name: marketing-campaign
description: Launch brief → strategy → per-channel drafts → brand-voice gate → schedule. A strategist sets one core message; `map` fans the writer out across channels (blog / social / email) so each gets its own angle; a refinement `loop` re-drafts against the brand reviewer until it replies [APPROVED]; a final locked phase lays out the publish calendar. Showcases `map` (fan-out over channels) and `loop` (quality-gated revision) in one flow.

inputs.name: brief
inputs.description: The launch / campaign brief — what's shipping, why it matters, and to whom.
